# TSPDV — Private Chauffeur, French Riviera

> TSPDV (taxisaintpaul.fr) is a private chauffeur house based in Saint-Paul-de-Vence, on the French Riviera. Licensed drivers, Mercedes V-Class and saloon cars, fixed fares agreed before departure. Area served: Menton to Saint-Tropez, including Nice, Cannes, Antibes and Monaco. The site is available in English (default) and French (add `?lang=fr` to any address).

Bookings are taken by phone at +33 6 09 28 55 36 or through the contact page. Fixed-fare journeys can also be booked and paid online with Maison Vehira, the sister chauffeur service run by the same company.

## Services

- [Private chauffeur on the French Riviera](https://taxisaintpaul.fr/chauffeur-prive-cote-dazur.php): hourly hire and point-to-point journeys between Menton and Saint-Tropez
- [Nice Airport transfers](https://taxisaintpaul.fr/airport-transfer-nice.php): meet and greet at Nice Côte d'Azur Airport, terminals 1 and 2, and the business aviation terminal
- [Private chauffeur in Monaco](https://taxisaintpaul.fr/private-chauffeur-monaco.php): transfers to and from the Principality, Grand Prix and events
- [Event chauffeur in Cannes](https://taxisaintpaul.fr/event-chauffeur-cannes.php): Film Festival, MIPIM, Cannes Lions and other congresses
- [Yacht-side service in Antibes](https://taxisaintpaul.fr/yacht-side-service-antibes.php): pick-up and drop-off at the quays of Port Vauban and the Riviera marinas
- [Villa transfers in Provence](https://taxisaintpaul.fr/villa-transfers-provence.php): journeys to villas and estates in the hinterland
